## Review-fix rerun — commit `b3474b48`

The review fixes have been pushed to PR #5752. The results below supersede the earlier validation sections in this comment. The public model id is `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3`; the local checkpoint overlay was used only for validation.

Environment: 4x NVIDIA B300 (`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5,6,7`), BF16, CuTe FlashAttention-4 (`flash_attn.cute.interface.flash_attn_func`), Ulysses=4, Ring=1, TP=1, VAE patch parallel=4 in tile mode, regional compile, no CPU/layer offload, 2 denoise steps, requested duration=4.0s, 24 FPS. Every output passed `ffprobe` as H.264 video + AAC 32 kHz stereo.

Review fixes covered:
- Request validation now raises `OmniClientError`, preserving the OpenAI API 400 response metadata.
- H3 multipart media reads are bounded and enforce the H3 image/video/audio size and format allowlists before conversion.
- The official two-video reference pair is accepted despite a 15.008334s container-duration rounding overrun, while real overflows still fail.
- Typed data-URL videos are persisted to a temporary MP4 source path before Ref2VA preparation.
- Mixed image+video references are accepted only when the diffusion model advertises that capability; MiniMax H3 enables it.

## MiniMax H3 official input matrix E2E

Validated on PR head `a6d70e6e` with the public model id `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3`. The local checkpoint overlay was used only for validation.

Environment:
- 4x NVIDIA B300 (`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5,6,7`), BF16
- FA4: `flash_attn.cute.interface.flash_attn_func` (CuTe FlashAttention-4)
- Ulysses=4, Ring=1, TP=1, VAE patch parallel=4 with tile mode, regional compile enabled, no CPU/layer offload
- 2 denoise steps, requested duration=4.0s, 24 FPS, Ref2VA short edge=768
- All final outputs passed ffprobe as H.264 video + AAC 32 kHz stereo. The pipeline produced 107 aligned frames (container duration 4.482s).

Input notes:
- R1 uses three valid-ratio visual references from the local/official model-launch materials; R4-R6 use constructed 32 kHz stereo reference audio inputs.
- R7/R8 use the official green-screen reference video. R9/R10 use the provided official `input-video-2.mov` served through a local HTTP URL; the attached signed URL had expired with HTTP 419, so the local HTTP mapping was used to exercise URL download/source preservation.
- R10 uses an HTTP image URL as well, which exercises the typed URL path without exceeding the generic 1 MiB form-field limit for base64 data URLs.

R4 also caught a distributed-path issue during E2E: non-zero DiT ranks intentionally have `prepared_videos=None`, so the visual-reference guard now uses the global `video_count`. This keeps video + standalone-audio requests from being misclassified as audio-only on those ranks.

## Official MiniMax-H3 T2VA accuracy test

The documentation and named E2E accuracy case are now aligned with the official `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3` checkpoint:

| Case | Checkpoint / configuration | Workload | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| T2VA official-reference accuracy | `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3` `FL2VA`, model revision `73372e6cf53e414edd3ab03e357717fb0602e758`; 4x NVIDIA B300 (physical GPUs 4-7), FA4 (`FLASH_ATTN`), USP=4, Ring=1, HSDP shard=4, text-encoder TP=4, tiled VAE patch parallel=4 | 50 steps, 1344x768, 24 fps, 243 frames / 10 s, seed=0 | **PASS** — SSIM **0.843701** (threshold >= 0.82), PSNR **21.310656 dB** (threshold >= 20 dB) |

The generated MP4 is H.264 + AAC, 1344x768, 24 fps, 32 kHz audio, and 10.157 s:

[Download generated MiniMax-H3 T2VA accuracy video](https://github.com/david6666666/vllm-omni/releases/download/minimax-h3-4gpu-validation-reviewfix-b3474b48/minimax_h3_t2va_accuracy_pr5752_b3474b48.mp4)

Command used:

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5,6,7 FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1 \
VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn VLLM_OMNI_VIDEO_SYNC_TIMEOUT=3600 \
VLLM_TEST_MINIMAX_H3_FL2VA_MODEL=/home/zjy/code/lsy/bench_inputs/MiniMax-H3/FL2VA \
/home/zjy/code/david/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -s -v \
tests/e2e/accuracy/minimax_h3/test_minimax_h3_t2va_similarity.py::test_minimax_h3_t2va_matches_official_reference
```

The pinned model revision remains fixed. The official `assets/t2va.mp4` URL under that revision currently returns 404, so the test uses the official `main/assets/t2va.mp4` endpoint and verifies its content SHA256 (`d66903241362e224085cc93f7a5e70fba6ab378d0ac6ff6af83acf2559849a42`) before comparison. The local run completed with `1 passed` in 422.51 s, and the four test GPUs were released on shutdown.

## MiniMax H3 accuracy-test URL follow-up

- The previous model revision `73372e6cf53e414edd3ab03e357717fb0602e758` now returns HTTP 404 (`Revision Not Found`), so the accuracy test now resolves the model from the current `main` revision.
- The official reference link is now `https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/assets/t2va.mp4`.
- Because Hugging Face `/blob/` URLs serve an HTML page, the test converts that link to the corresponding `/resolve/` URL only when downloading the bytes.
- Verified the downloaded MP4 and its expected SHA256: `d66903241362e224085cc93f7a5e70fba6ab378d0ac6ff6af83acf2559849a42`.
- Fix pushed in commit `710d4fec`.
